verdict.rationale: CDP documents a Checkouts API that creates a single-use checkout and returns a payment URL for the customer to pay in USDC or USDT. It adds an auth/capture flow with captures, voids and refunds, plus settlement details. Deposit destinations give stable addresses that auto-credit the account, and webhooks deliver real-time HTTP notifications for programmatic confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a checkout or payment-completed webhook or status-polling event tied to settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can accept a stablecoin payment from a customer through a documented checkout or payment API — create the payment, present the address or flow, and confirm settlement programmatically

citations.quote: Creates a new checkout. Returns a payment URL to redirect your customer to. Each checkout is single-use.
Accept stablecoin payments at checkout with a two-step auth and capture flow, without onchain complexity
When a deposit arrives, the corresponding account's balance is credited automatically.
Receive real-time HTTP notifications when things happen across your CDP integration.
